cards.title: CONTEXT.md: Project
cards.summary: Disclosure: a realistic documentary history of the UFO phenomenon, from ancient texts to the October 2026 disclosure record, then labeled projections. Plain markdown book; no build.

cards.title: CONTEXT.md: Structure
cards.summary: outline/OUTLINE.md: 45-chapter lineout (purpose + sources per chapter); source of truth for order
key_facts: manuscript/part-1..part-5/chNN.md: chapter stubs (lineout only, no prose yet)
history/TIMELINE.md [T-NNN], history/MODERNCASESFACTS.md [MC-NNN]: historian claim files (IDs used in footnotes); history/IDINDEX.md, OPENQUESTIONS.md,...
research/ANCIENTTIMELINE.md, research/MODERNCASES.md: research briefs
rules/STORYRULES.md: canon rules + footnote convention
QUESTIONS-LOG.md, notes/: questions, reuse review, publishing plan

cards.title: CONTEXT.md: Operating Constraints
cards.summary: Real people keep real names; real reported events and established lore only; nothing invented; symbolism only when grounded in cited research.
read_when: before choosing an implementation or changing project behavior
key_facts: Nordic and reptilian beings are modern lore: always name the originators (contactee era / George Adamski; David Icke) and never present them as ancient fact.
Projection chapters (Part V) must be labeled PROJECTION and grounded in the Part IV record.
Footnote only claims that need it, as [^T-NNN]/[^MC-NNN] keyed to historian IDs; no historian entry = research gap, not a footnote.
research/MODERNCASES.md may be under edit by another worker: coordinate before touching; pull --rebase before pushing.

cards.title: CONTEXT.md: Workflow
read_when: running, testing, linting, deploying, or verifying changes
key_facts: Run: none
Verify: node scripts/context-index.js check
Every chapter stub lists sources; every footnote ID exists in history/.

cards.title: CONTEXT.md: Language
cards.summary: Claim ID: historian entry ID, T-NNN (history/TIMELINE.md) or MC-NNN (history/MODERNCASESFACTS.md). Avoid: raw URL as footnote key.
read_when: using canonical project terms or resolving naming ambiguity
key_facts: Lineout: chapter title + one-line purpose + sources, no prose.
